		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 12 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 12 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_11 = mdr_space_ch_12 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 13 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 13 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_12 = mdr_space_ch_13 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 14 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 14 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_13 = mdr_space_ch_14 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 15 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_14 = mdr_space_ch_15 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 16 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 16 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_15 = mdr_space_ch_16 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 17 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 17 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_16 = mdr_space_ch_17 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 18 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 18 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_17 = mdr_space_ch_18 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 19 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 19 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_18 = mdr_space_ch_19 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 20 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 20 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_19 = mdr_space_ch_20 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 21 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 21 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_20 = mdr_space_ch_21 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 22 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 22 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_21 = mdr_space_ch_22 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 23 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 23 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_22 = mdr_space_ch_23 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 24 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 24 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_23 = mdr_space_ch_24 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 25 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 25 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_24 = mdr_space_ch_25 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 26 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 26 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_25 = mdr_space_ch_26 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 27 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 27 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_26 = mdr_space_ch_27 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 28 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 28 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_27 = mdr_space_ch_28 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 29 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 29 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_28 = mdr_space_ch_29 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 30 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 30 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_29 = mdr_space_ch_30 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret < 31 } check_variable = { mdr_space_len > 31 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_30 = mdr_space_ch_31 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_0 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 2 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_1 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 3 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_2 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_3 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_4 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 6 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_5 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 7 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_6 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 8 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_7 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 9 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_8 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 10 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_9 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 11 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_10 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 12 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_11 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 13 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_12 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 14 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_13 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 15 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_14 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 16 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_15 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 17 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_16 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 18 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_17 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 19 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_18 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 20 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_19 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 21 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_20 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 22 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_21 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 23 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_22 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 24 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_23 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 25 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_24 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 26 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_25 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 27 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_26 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 28 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_27 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 29 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_28 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 30 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_29 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 31 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_30 = 0 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_len = 32 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_ch_31 = 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_space_len = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
	}
}

mdr_space_caret_left = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_caret > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_space_caret = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
	}
}

mdr_space_caret_right = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_space_caret compare = less_than value = mdr_space_len } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_space_caret = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
	}
}
